module.name: Email notifications
module.description: Sends an email when incidents open and resolve (screen or agent offline, power failure).

smtp_host.title: SMTP server
smtp_host.description: Host name of the outgoing mail server. Set by the VDS_SMTP_HOST environment variable.

smtp_security.title: Encryption
smtp_security.description: starttls or tls; there is no plain mode and the certificate is always verified. Set by VDS_SMTP_SECURITY.

smtp_password.title: SMTP password
smtp_password.description: Never shown nor stored in the database: provided only by VDS_SMTP_PASSWORD.

from.title: Sender address
from.description: Sender of the emails. Set by VDS_MAIL_FROM.

notify_admins.title: Notify administrators
notify_admins.description: Sends notifications to all active administrator accounts.

extra_recipients.title: Additional recipients
extra_recipients.description: Email addresses notified in addition to administrators.

kinds.title: Notified incident types
kinds.description: Incident types that trigger an email.

send_resolved.title: Notify on resolution
send_resolved.description: Also sends an email when the incident is resolved.

notify_mail.not_configured: No SMTP server is configured (VDS_SMTP_HOST and VDS_MAIL_FROM).
notify_mail.smtp_auth: The SMTP server rejected the authentication.
notify_mail.smtp_tls: The SMTP server certificate could not be verified.
notify_mail.timeout: The SMTP server is not responding.
notify_mail.connect: Could not connect to the SMTP server.
notify_mail.smtp_rejected: The SMTP server rejected the message.

intro.opened: An incident has just been detected.
